title: Unsafe Type Assertion vs Runtime Boundary Parsing
description: Compare compile-time type casting against safeParse boundary enforcement on untrusted API payloads.

before.label: Blind Type Cast (Runtime Drift Uncaught)
before.previewNote: TypeScript passes at build time, then throws TypeError in production when API shape drifts.

after.label: Boundary Parser (Fail Explicit at I/O)
after.previewNote: Corrupted payloads are quarantined at the fetch boundary before touching UI state.
